From dorm essentials to classroom tech, here’s what's trending for back-to-school season at Best Buy Canada
results.description: Back-to-school season is right around the corner, and this year, we’re shopping smarter. Maybe you’re living that student life, applying for an internship, or revamping your existing office space. Whatever is on your tech wishlist, Best Buy Canada is a one-stop shop for smart essentials and expert support. Here are some top tech picks to browse in the Best Buy Canada Back-To-School Guide to help you start the school year off strong. MEMORY-MAKERS Digital and instant cameras are making a comeback, and if you want to capture memories in physical form, there are plenty of great options to choose from. The Canon PowerShot ELPH 360 is a sleek camera that offers striking clarity, while the Fujifilm Instax Mini 13 is beloved for its polaroid pics. If in-depth content creation is calling your name, or you’re taking a media course, the Insta360 X5 Waterproof captures smooth footage in stunning detail, while the Sony ZV-1F Content Creator Vlogger is designed specifically for — you guessed it — vlogging. LAPTOPS AND TABLETS Whether you’re taking notes in class, collaborating on group projects, or tackling late-night study sessions, a reliable laptop or tablet is a back-to-school essential. The Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ or Lenovo IdeaPad Slim Laptop are versatile options that can help keep you productive from lecture halls to the library and everywhere in between. The Dell 15.6 Laptop is a solid everyday choice for everything from note-taking and research to streaming and coursework. For students looking for additional performance, portability and AI-powered features, the ASUS Zenbook A14 and Acer Swift 14 AI offer enhanced capabilities to help support demanding workloads throughout the school year. TUNING IN OR TUNING OUT Some sounds you want to hear, like the score of the game you’re playing or a call home from family. Others, like the distractions that come with studying in busy spaces like the library, should be easier to tune out. Whatever you’re tuning in or out of, the Bose Quiet Comfort Ultra Headphones, SteelSeries Artics Nova Gaming Headset, or Apple AirPods 4 can help. AT-HOME ESSENTIALS Whether you’re moving into a dorm, your first rental, or want to give your place a work-from-home refresh, a few tech upgrades can make all the difference. The Acer Aspire Desktop PC will be by your side for the long haul thanks to its high responsiveness, large storage capacity, and enhanced performance for multitasking and entertainment. Pair that with the Ljubljana 47′′ Electric Height Adjustable Standing Desk and Ninja Pods & Grounds Single-Serve Coffee Maker, and you’ve got all the makings for a productive day at the “office.” FUN EXTRAS When it comes to studying or working, balance is key. Stay on top of your physical health (while staying super stylish) with the help of an Oura Ring 5 Smart Ring or Google Fitbit Air Screenless Fitness Tracker. And if you’re all about keeping up to date with the latest technology advancements, Best Buy Canada can keep you well-equipped. Products like the Meta Adventurer Glasses and DJI Mini 3 Quadcopter Drone & Remote Control are generating plenty of hype, and you can get in on the action. The right tech setup can make all the difference for students and young professionals in staying productive, creative, and connected as they embrace each new experience this time of year brings. Start the school year strong with Best Buy, your one-stop destination for back-to-school tech.

results.title: The Ingredients For Planets Turned Up Astonishingly Early
results.description: Planet building was supposed to be one of the universe's slow projects, something that only got going billions of years after the Big Bang. New research suggests otherwise. The raw materials for rocky worlds, and perhaps even the water needed for life, may have been ready to go just 100 million years after the Big Bang, long before the first galaxies had even taken shape.
